newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares seen steady to slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares seen steady to slightly firmer.

text.p: 0715 GMT - Dutch shares are expected to open steady to slightly firmer across the board, supported by a firm dollar and a 73 point gain for the Dow after U.S. monetary authorities left interest rates unchanged on Wednesday as expected.
* AEX share index closed at new record high on Wednesday, rising 7.71 points to 879.02.
